mapper.sql: id, company_id, job_id, candidate_id, channel, score, score_reason, status, current_stage, applied_at, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO opc_hr_application (id, company_id, job_id, candidate_id, channel, score, score_reason, status, current_stage, applied_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{companyId}, #{jobId}, #{candidateId}, #{channel}, #{score}, #{scoreReason}, #{status}, #{currentStage}, #{appliedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT status AS status, COUNT(1) AS count FROM opc_hr_application WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND applied_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{sinceDays} DAY) GROUP BY status

SELECT AVG(DATEDIFF(o.responded_at, a.applied_at)) AS avg_days FROM opc_hr_offer o JOIN opc_hr_application a ON o.application_id = a.id WHERE a.company_id = #{companyId} AND o.status = 'ACCEPTED' AND o.responded_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{sinceDays} DAY)
